answer_1.quote: We focus on image descriptions because it is relatively easy for humans to judge whether a given description correctly describes an image.
answer_1.outputs: A woman in a pink skirt throws a frisbee.

answer_2.quote: Recent years have seen a growing discomfort with the use of automatic metrics like BLEU for the evaluation of natural language generation (NLG) systems.

answer_4.quote: We used network sampling to recruit 61 volunteers (35 female, 26 male; 59 native, 2 fluent speakers of Chinese) to participate in our study.
answer_4.guideline: participants rated the quality of the erroneous description on a continuous scale from 0 (worst) to 100 (best), using a slider
